brief:
Israel's parliament was sworn in on Tuesday without a new government in place, Al-Monitor reported. A deadlocked general election has left Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu without a parliamentary majority while denying his main rivals the numbers needed to govern.

Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief, is attempting to forge a governing coalition from the fractured results. The political impasse leaves Israel without a functioning cabinet as negotiations continue among competing factions.

title: Israel's parliament convenes without new government formed
